name: artifact-sftp
description: Publish self-contained HTML artifacts to your own SFTP web host with a stable URL and private-by-default visibility — a stand-in for the native Artifact tool on runtimes that lack it (Codex, OpenClaw).

interface.shortDescription: Publish HTML artifacts to your own SFTP web host
interface.longDescription: Uploads one self-contained HTML file per artifact to an SFTP web host and returns a stable, redeploy-in-place URL that is private (HTTP basic auth) by default. Mimics the contract of the native Artifact tool for Codex and OpenClaw, which have no built-in artifact publishing.
defaultPrompt: Publish this report as an artifact
Update my published artifact in place
Set up artifact-sftp on this machine
